To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
eye gaze patterns reveal how learning experiences improve reasoning skills.
learning improves reasoning and this improvement is mediated by changes in relational thinking.

1) reasoning skills improved after studying for the LSAC’s Logic Games section of a law school admissions test (LSAT), 2) eyetracking data revealed an increase in efficiency of relational thinking after completing the Logic Games section, and 3) the efficiency of relational thinking was associated with improved response time performance across reasoning assessments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how learning changes the brain, and how the brain can be used to measure the effects of learning on cognition.
the question: how do people learn?
the mechanisms of change in reasoning ability, a high-level cognitive ability that is important to many aspects of human life.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
eye gaze patterns reveal how improvements in reasoning skills occur with experience.
eye gaze patterns revealed how reasoning skills improve as a function of learning experiences.
the eye gaze patterns reveal how relational thinking improved with experience.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
eye gaze patterns can reveal how reasoning skills are honed with experience, and that these changes are related to improvements in the efficiency with which we integrate key pieces of information.
the eye gaze data provide an objective measure of relational thinking that can help us understand the mechanisms of reasoning skill change, which is a critical question in the study of learning.
eye gaze can be used to reveal learning mechanisms that are not evident in behavioral data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
eye tracking is a powerful tool that can be applied to study a variety of learning mechanisms in the context of different types of learning experiences.
the high temporal precision of eyetracking and the rich derivable parameters make it a powerful method for probing learning mechanisms.
learning can be measured in real time using eye gaze patterns and that these patterns can reveal the mechanisms of change.
